interface.name: 榜单与信号首页
interface.purpose_zh: 首页为两行三列：中间上下两格展示信号，左右四格展示榜单。榜单说明谁值得关注，信号说明发生了什么。
interface.purpose_en: Two rows and three columns: signals in the center column, four boards on the sides. Boards show who merits attention; signals show what happened.
display_zh: 按行从左到右编号：1左上升温、2中上信号、3右上最热、4左下新发现、5中下信号、6右下第四榜待绑定。
四榜的具体格位目前是Studio结构占位，不代表已核验/app对应关系；第四榜来源与信号分组不猜测。
最热使用七日相对放量RVOL；旧量价评分及旧升温条件使用相对昨日比值，两者比较基准不同。
榜单/信号来源引用不代表已接通查询API或网站同步；#1009网站同步由用户另补卡。
display_en: Row-major positions: 1 top-left Warming, 2 top-center signal, 3 top-right Hottest, 4 bottom-left Newly discovered, 5 bottom-center signal, 6 bottom-right fourth board unbound.
Board positions are Studio placeholders; their /app mapping is unverified. Fourth-board source and signal groups remain unbound.
Hottest uses seven-day RVOL; legacy scoring and warming gates use the previous-day ratio. Their comparison baselines differ.
Source references do not establish read APIs or website synchronization. The user owns the separate #1009 sync card.
actions_zh: 当前只查看六框结构与来源定义；真实资产详情导航待实现。
actions_en: Inspect the six positions and their source definitions; real asset navigation is pending.
limitations_zh: 本卡仅展示结构，没有真实榜单或信号记录。
中间两格信号、两边四榜是已确认设计；现有/app运行状态、完整格位与信号分组未核验。
升温生成卡仍收起；最热已有独立快照算法，新发现按系统首次建档时间，规则定义不证明真实输出。
第四榜未绑定来源；本站查询API、网站同步及信号持久化不由本次修改实现。
limitations_en: Structure only, without real board or signal records.
Center signals and four side boards are confirmed; live /app state, exact positions and signal groups remain unverified.
Warming remains shelved; Hottest has a snapshot algorithm and Newly discovered uses first registration time. Definitions do not prove real output.
Fourth-board source is unbound. This edit does not implement read APIs, website sync or signal persistence.
